ci: drop stale prebuild hook calling @freegamestore/cli@latest

The hook ran the compliance CLI from inside web/, the wrong cwd:
LICENSE is one level up, web/index.html resolves to web/web/index.html,
and the VitePWA manifest source path can't match. Every game with this
hook fails compliance with phantom errors.

The reusable workflow at freegamestore-online/freegamestore runs the
same CLI from the repo root with a pinned version, so this prebuild
is redundant and actively breaking deploys.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Strip multiplayer — moving to ProGameStore

Cloudflare Pages can't host a Worker that defines a Durable Object class,
so the WebSocket-backed multiplayer was failing every deploy. Per the
platform decision in ~/dev/stores/CLAUDE.md (2026-05-20), real-time rooms
are now a Pro-tier feature, not Free. Multiplayer chess will live at
progamestore-online/chess once PGS is built out.

Removed:
- web/public/_worker.js (the GameDO Worker)
- web/src/components/MultiplayerTab.tsx
- /multiplayer + /g/<id> routes in App.tsx
- Multiplayer button in the topbar
- Manual sw.js registration in index.html (VitePWA handles it)
- Durable Objects + migrations blocks in wrangler.jsonc

The full multiplayer code is staged at ~/dev/stores/pgs/games/chess/ for
the eventual PGS launch.

Kept: local play vs. engine, puzzles, voice control, preferences,
analysis, eval bar, move list — everything that doesn't need a server.

feat(play): Hint button shows engine's best move as live arrow

Pressing Hint on your turn calls Stockfish (or minimax fallback) and
draws a yellow arrow on the live board from the recommended source to
target square. The arrow clears automatically on the next move. The
button is only enabled when it's your turn, and shows a "Hint…" label
while the engine is thinking.

Board gains a new `liveArrow` prop that renders independently of the
preview-mode arrow used for alternative-move review.

Game.tsx: first coin in a chain shouldn't already cash at ×2

bumpMult() ran before the coin was credited, so the very first coin of a
fresh chain applied at ×2 even though no chain existed yet. Apply mult
first (which is 1 on a cold start), then bump it so the *next* coin
hits at ×2. Matches the "first match starts the combo" intuition.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.7 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

Features: combo multiplier, spike hazards, power-ups

Combo:
- Each coin pickup extends a 3s window; consecutive pickups stack a ×2/×3/×4
  multiplier on coin value. Distance scoring stays 1× so idling can't
  build a combo.
- Multiplier shown both in the topbar (Combo stat appears when > 1) and
  big at the top-center of the play area, with a decay bar underneath.

Hazards:
- Some platforms spawn with red saw-tooth strips inset from the edges.
  Touching one is lethal.
- Spawn rate ramps from 0% (first 15s) to 32% by 90s, so early game stays
  forgiving.

Power-ups (~8% of coin-bearing platforms):
- Blue double-jump: one extra mid-air jump for 8s. Sparkles on use.
- Purple slow-mo: world ticks at 45% for 3s; controls stay at full speed
  so it's an offensive ability, not just a "pause to think" cheat.
- Gold shield: absorbs one spike hit (bounce + combo reset) or one fall.
  Pulsing aura while active.
- Active power-ups stack as small badges in the top-left with charges or
  time remaining. Slow-mo paints a faint purple tint over the play area.

ci: drop ci.yml and compliance.yml — superseded by reusable workflow

ci.yml was a single typecheck-on-PR step; the new reusable workflow's
build step does `tsc -b` as part of `pnpm build`, covering it.

compliance.yml was 50+ lines of grep-based file checks (tracking SDKs,
brand fonts, manifest fields, bundle size). All of these are now run
by @freegamestore/cli inside the reusable workflow, and that CLI
covers more (brand-token leaks, audio mute hook, store link, etc.)
than the hand-rolled grep checks did.

The hook ran the compliance CLI from inside web/, the wrong cwd:
LICENSE is one level up, web/index.html resolves to web/web/index.html,
and the VitePWA manifest source path can't match. Every game with this
hook fails compliance with phantom errors.

The reusable workflow at freegamestore-online/freegamestore runs the
same CLI from the repo root with a pinned version, so this prebuild
is redundant and actively breaking deploys.
